Next year's iPhone Pro model is expected to adopt a brand new all-glass design to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone launch. And today, a new leak detailed Apple's progress on these innovative models.

Here's the latest news about Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

It's only a few weeks away from the debut of Apple's first foldable model — the innovative iPhone Ultra. But next year will bring another new iPhone with a unique design.

There are rumors that Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro models. According to reports, these new models will feature larger screens with a quad-curved display that extends to the edges of the body, creating a visually borderless effect.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted a new message today, updating Apple's progress in achieving this unique look.

He said that Apple is using the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but is making modifications to use a more rounded material.

The post also mentioned improvements in two areas:

  • Heat dissipation
  • Slimness

It's still too early to determine the body thickness and design materials Apple is pursuing. However, current indications suggest that this new model will draw inspiration from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not prioritize slimness in the same way.

Based on these latest updates, it sounds like we can expect to see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra on this model, while still delivering the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.

Pro users don't want slimness to be listed as a priority. But if Apple can deliver a comparable experience in a slightly slimmer device, paired with a unique all-glass look, it would be very appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumored iPhone Pro 20 model? Let us know in the comments.
